verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents partial layer offloading (splitting a model between CPU and GPU) or running models larger than VRAM. It shows only that llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan, and that it can fall back to CPU-only inference. One community report of an 8GB-VRAM laptop running mostly on the CPU reads as a user question, not as evidence of deliberate hybrid offload.
